title.narrative: Establishing an Environment Fund for Kiribati

description.narrative: Th is project will provide technical assistance and capacity building training needed for the Env ironment Conservation Division (ECD) of Ministry of Environment, Lands and Agriculture Division (MELAD) , to establish Kiribati´s Environment Fund , a financial mechanism expected to deliver long term, inclusive and effective solutions to adapt/mitigate climate change and build resilience .

The overall objective of the project is to support the Government of Kiribati to design, establish, and operationalise a fit-for-purpose national Environment Fund that can sustainably finance climate and environmental priorities, while being inclusive, transparent, and aligned with legal and fiduciary standards. The project aims to ensure that the Fund is accessible to a wide range of beneficiaries—including women, youth, and marginalised communities—and that it can effectively attract, manage, and disburse funding from both domestic and international sources. Through a phased, participatory process, the project will define the Fund’s purpose, legal and institutional structure, operational procedures, and communication strategy. Ultimately, the project seeks to create a high-integrity financial mechanism that strengthens Kiribati’s capacity to respond to climate and environmental challenges at scale, while enhancing coordination, building local ownership, and improving long-term resilience.
